news.headline: Photinus and Schréder join forces to bring solar lighting to communities worldwide

paragraphs: Schréder sells outdoor lighting equipment, with a product menu listing luminaires, poles and brackets, control systems, smart poles, solar and retrofit solutions. The company also sells lighting control software, listing Schréder EXEDRA Genius as a Smart Lighting Optimisation platform.

One solutions page describes smart lighting for cities and communities, covering urban and residential streets, squares and pedestrian areas, bike and pedestrian paths, and accent and architectural lighting. A second page covers sports lighting for local clubs through to large stadia, including football and rugby pitch lighting, multi-sports hall lighting, tennis and padel court lighting, and swimming pool lighting.

A third page covers transport hubs, naming railway stations and metros, ports and waterways, and airports as the applications for these lighting systems. On the sports page, the benefits described go to players, visitors and sports club managers.

quote.text: Light up your city, optimise your energy
